review.scope: Read-only audit only; not receipt reconciliation, not product103 package, not Native proof.

generic_lessons: Read-only diagnostics must not call product Inspect methods that may reconcile and write receipts.
Absent properties, failed reads and malformed values need distinct statuses; per-namespace unknown data should not erase independently known evidence.
Freeze validated copies before cross-read comparison, and never execute function-shaped stored values.
Lua5.1 compile failure remains source syntax failure despite complete SSE and valid outer JSON.
Version installation, startup, MainMenu context list, load ACK and actual loaded world are different evidence levels.
Formal menu navigation may activate the client; separate it from independent background read-only offline proof.
Offline mode evidence does not mean remote account idle. Occupancy restrictions still forbid online/login/download/upload.

Only retire an owned exited residue after validating its save, identity, absent windows/listeners, idle CPU and elapsed time. An unresponsive startup is not a clean successful exit or a proven product cause.
scope_limit: Read-only QA counts only; zero owner tool or raw-model Native executions, not procurement receipts or gameplay success. Product90 unchanged103files.
